description: EU Due-Diligence report for an international company. Input: 20-char LEI code, or company name + optional country. Returns GLEIF entity data (status, address, registration number) plus sanctions screening against EU/OFAC lists. Coverage notes per country included. Note: GLEIF covers mid/large firms with LEI — SMEs may not be found. Pro Compliance tier or higher.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code — helps narrow name search, not needed for LEI lookup.

name: get_eu_dd_report
